observe.surface: The Field Notes screen: the Android phone layout first, then the macOS window (Today, day detail, the capture recorders, the garden and Meadow, calendar, search, settings).
observe.value: The exact text, state or accessibility label a widget shows, such as a saved entry's text, a streak count or whether a button is enabled; never mere presence.
observe.observe_by: flutter_test widget tests on the real widget tree; integration_test on macOS for platform code; live, a debug build in the VM lab (lab) driven through its Dart VM service.
observe.terminal_action: The control that commits: Save on a capture or note, a recorder's Stop or Keep, confirming a delete or an export; the screen then re-renders from the Drift database.
observe.build_artifact: A debug or release build made from the commit's git sha and installed in a VM lab instance (macOS or Android); for tests, the checked-out commit.
observe.twin: The macOS and Android versions of one feature: the vendored camera_macos package against the camera plugin in CameraVideoRecorder, macos/ against android/ platform code, the phone layout against the desktop layout of the same screen.
observe.dependent: Drift tables and their build_runner output feed the repositories in lib/data, which feed the Riverpod providers in lib/state and then the screens; design tokens feed every screen and the golden images checked by the goldens CI workflow.
observe.receipt: A flutter_test widget or unit test under test/ that is red on base and green on head; for platform-only behaviour, an integration_test under integration_test/ run on macOS.
observe.compat_boundary: None on main: the app is local-only and every install is rebuilt from scratch, so no data migration is kept. Once device sync merges: two devices on different app builds talking to the relay, gated by its protocol version.

reach.access: No account or sign-in exists on main. Start a clean macOS or Android instance from the VM lab (lab), install a debug build of the commit, and drive it through its Dart VM service. Never run flutter drive on the owner's phone.
reach.shortcut: A debug build's Dart VM service drives the app with no taps or screen capture; seeded installs come from ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/device-pass/install_seeded.zsh; the composer probe app lives in integration_test/probe; pin meadowKeyProvider for comparable Meadow screenshots.
reach.fixtures: No backend. A fresh install starts empty; seeded installs and integration_test/fixtures supply realistic journals and media; all test data is disposable.
special_surfaces: GPU performance (Impeller frame timing, the Meadow scene): the VM lab's Android emulator on an M4 Mac does not replicate a phone GPU, so a pass there proves nothing about phones, while a failure there is conclusive and needs no phone. A performance pass needs the real phone, with the Note 10+ as the low-end floor check.
Camera and microphone recorders, and reminder notifications: the VM lab replicates these and is the primary check; the real phone is a redundant second check, not a requirement.
